predicates.name: pending_database_change_details_listed_and_explicitly_confirmed
predicates.description: The agent previously listed the material details of the pending database change, the user subsequently explicitly replied yes to those details, and the listed details match the pending call arguments.

predicates.name: booking_required_information_established
predicates.description: The user ID, trip type, origin, and destination are established in earlier user messages or tool outputs, and the pending booking arguments match those values.

predicates.name: booking_has_at_most_five_passengers
predicates.description: The pending booking contains no more than five passengers.

predicates.name: passenger_identity_details_established
predicates.description: The first name, last name, and date of birth for every passenger in the pending booking are established in earlier user messages or tool outputs, and match the pending arguments.

predicates.name: all_booking_passengers_share_flights_and_cabin
predicates.description: The pending booking assigns every passenger the same flights and the same cabin.

predicates.name: booking_payment_method_counts_within_limits
predicates.description: The pending booking uses no more than one travel certificate, no more than one credit card, and no more than three gift cards.

predicates.name: booking_payment_methods_found_in_user_profile
predicates.description: Every payment method in the pending booking appears in an earlier tool output showing the user's profile.

predicates.name: booking_user_is_regular_member
predicates.description: An earlier tool output identifies the booking user as a regular member.

predicates.name: regular_member_booking_baggage_counts_correct
predicates.description: The pending booking's total and nonfree baggage counts match the checked-bag allowances for a regular member and the cabin of each passenger, with nonfree baggage accounting for bags beyond the applicable free allowance.

predicates.name: booking_user_is_silver_member
predicates.description: An earlier tool output identifies the booking user as a silver member.

predicates.name: silver_member_booking_baggage_counts_correct
predicates.description: The pending booking's total and nonfree baggage counts match the checked-bag allowances for a silver member and the cabin of each passenger, with nonfree baggage accounting for bags beyond the applicable free allowance.

predicates.name: booking_user_is_gold_member
predicates.description: An earlier tool output identifies the booking user as a gold member.

predicates.name: gold_member_booking_baggage_counts_correct
predicates.description: The pending booking's total and nonfree baggage counts match the checked-bag allowances for a gold member and the cabin of each passenger, with nonfree baggage accounting for bags beyond the applicable free allowance.

predicates.name: booking_insurance_decision_established_and_matched
predicates.description: The user's decision about travel insurance is established in an earlier user message, and the pending booking's insurance argument matches that decision.

predicates.name: modification_user_and_reservation_ids_established
predicates.description: The user's ID and the reservation ID in the pending modification are established in earlier user messages or tool outputs, and the established reservation ID matches the pending call argument.

predicates.name: pending_flight_update_is_basic_economy
predicates.description: Earlier reservation details identify the reservation in the pending flight update as basic economy.

predicates.name: pending_flight_segments_are_unchanged
predicates.description: The flights in the pending update match all the reservation's current flight segments shown in earlier tool outputs.

predicates.name: origin_destination_and_trip_type_preserved
predicates.description: The origin, destination, and trip type in the pending flight update match the reservation details shown in earlier tool outputs.

predicates.name: all_pending_flight_segments_have_one_cabin
predicates.description: The cabin in the pending flight-update arguments is the same across every flight segment in the entire submitted reservation.

predicates.name: pending_baggage_total_not_reduced
predicates.description: The pending baggage update's total baggage count is at least the current total shown in earlier reservation details.

predicates.name: pending_passenger_count_unchanged
predicates.description: The number of passengers in the pending passenger update equals the number in earlier reservation details.

predicates.name: pending_flight_update_changes_flights
predicates.description: The flights in the pending update differ from the current reservation flights shown in earlier tool outputs.

predicates.name: user_selected_eligible_flight_change_payment_method
predicates.description: The user selected a gift card or credit card for the pending flight change's payment or refund method, and that selection matches the pending payment ID and is shown as a stored payment method in earlier profile outputs.

predicates.name: cancellation_context_established
predicates.description: The user's ID, the reservation ID in the pending cancellation, and a cancellation reason of change of plan, airline-cancelled flight, or other reasons are established in earlier user messages or tool outputs; the reservation ID matches the pending call argument.

predicates.name: cancellation_is_within_24_hours
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs or user messages establish that the reservation was booked within 24 hours of the current time stated in the policy.

predicates.name: airline_cancelled_flight_confirmed
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs or user messages establish that the airline cancelled a flight in the reservation.

predicates.name: reservation_has_business_cabin
predicates.description: Earlier reservation details identify a flight in the reservation as business cabin.

predicates.name: reservation_has_basic_or_economy_cabin
predicates.description: Earlier reservation details identify a flight in the reservation as basic economy or economy cabin.

predicates.name: reservation_has_travel_insurance
predicates.description: Earlier reservation details establish that travel insurance was bought for the reservation.

predicates.name: insured_cancellation_condition_met
predicates.description: Earlier user messages or tool outputs establish that the insured cancellation is needed for a health or weather reason.

predicates.name: reservation_has_no_used_flight_segments
predicates.description: Earlier reservation details establish that none of the reservation's flight segments has been used.

predicates.name: request_cannot_be_handled_with_available_tools
predicates.description: The conversation and earlier tool outputs establish that the user's request cannot be completed within the agent's stated scope and available tools, including situations the policy says the agent cannot help with.

predicates.name: user_complained_about_cancelled_flights
predicates.description: The user complained in an earlier message about cancelled flights in the relevant reservation.

predicates.name: user_complained_about_delayed_flights
predicates.description: The user complained in an earlier message about delayed flights in the relevant reservation.

predicates.name: user_explicitly_requested_compensation
predicates.description: The user explicitly requested compensation in an earlier message.

predicates.name: user_wants_change_or_cancellation_for_delay
predicates.description: The user stated in an earlier message that they want to change or cancel the relevant reservation because of a delay.

predicates.name: compensation_eligibility_established_for_reservation
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs establish that the user is silver or gold, has travel insurance for the relevant reservation, or flies business in that reservation.

predicates.name: cancelled_flight_compensation_facts_confirmed
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs confirm the cancelled-flight facts and establish the relevant reservation's passenger count, membership status, insurance status, and cabin.

predicates.name: delayed_flight_compensation_facts_confirmed
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs confirm the delayed-flight facts and establish the relevant reservation's passenger count, membership status, insurance status, and cabin.

predicates.name: relevant_reservation_changed_or_cancelled_before
predicates.description: Earlier successful tool outputs establish that the relevant reservation was changed or cancelled before the pending action.

predicates.name: pending_certificate_recipient_matches_relevant_user
predicates.description: The user ID in the pending certificate call matches the user associated with the relevant reservation in earlier tool outputs or conversation messages.

predicates.name: pending_certificate_amount_matches_cancelled_flight_formula
predicates.description: The amount in the pending certificate call equals $100 multiplied by the number of passengers in the relevant reservation shown in earlier tool outputs.

predicates.name: pending_certificate_amount_matches_delayed_flight_formula
predicates.description: The amount in the pending certificate call equals $50 multiplied by the number of passengers in the relevant reservation shown in earlier tool outputs.

predicates.name: cancelled_flight_certificate_send_conditions_met
predicates.description: Earlier messages establish a complaint about cancelled flights; earlier tool outputs confirm the relevant cancelled-flight facts and compensation eligibility; and the pending certificate recipient and amount match the relevant user and $100-per-passenger formula.

predicates.name: delayed_flight_certificate_send_conditions_met
predicates.description: Earlier messages establish a complaint about delayed flights and a wish to change or cancel the reservation; earlier tool outputs confirm the relevant delay facts, compensation eligibility, and a completed change or cancellation; and the pending certificate recipient and amount match the relevant user and $50-per-passenger formula.

predicates.name: pending_response_offers_cancelled_flight_certificate
predicates.description: The pending response offers or promises a gesture certificate concerning cancelled flights.

predicates.name: pending_response_offers_delayed_flight_certificate
predicates.description: The pending response offers or promises a gesture certificate concerning delayed flights.

predicates.name: pending_response_offers_any_compensation_certificate
predicates.description: The pending response offers or promises a certificate as compensation or a gesture.

predicates.name: cancelled_flight_certificate_response_conditions_and_amount_met
predicates.description: Earlier messages establish a complaint about cancelled flights; earlier tool outputs confirm the relevant cancelled-flight facts and compensation eligibility; and the pending response states $100 multiplied by the relevant reservation's passenger count.

predicates.name: delayed_flight_certificate_response_conditions_and_amount_met
predicates.description: Earlier messages establish a complaint about delayed flights and a wish to change or cancel the reservation; earlier tool outputs confirm the relevant delay facts, compensation eligibility, and a completed change or cancellation; and the pending response states $50 multiplied by the relevant reservation's passenger count.

predicates.name: user_complained_about_relevant_flight_situation
predicates.description: Earlier user messages establish a complaint about the cancelled or delayed flight situation relevant to the compensation being offered or sent.

predicates.name: compensation_is_prohibited_for_relevant_reservation
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs establish that the user is regular, has no travel insurance for the relevant reservation, and flies basic economy or economy in that reservation.

rules.description: Require listed booking details and explicit user confirmation before booking.
